title: Missing topology provenance is isolated to the affected component
blocker: The reference scanner now localizes incomplete topology provenance to the affected software-estimated component, but the Qman product kernel-native shadow-domain ABI, signed HostSnapshot publisher, target-code integration, and physical qualification are not implemented.
assertions: missing or inconsistent provenance makes the complete affected topology component unknown
no member of an unknown component can become production eligible
a disjoint component with complete provenance retains its prior capability and hashes
publisher snapshot and reasons identify the exact missing source and affected component
